title: D3-3a N01: Maximum Tolerable Salinity During a Post-Algal High-Salinity Intrusion
question_prompt: After normalization to reference conditions, permeate flow has declined by 12%, salt passage is unchanged, and normalized stage pressure drop has increased by 4%. Decide whether membrane cleaning is required under the manufacturer's operating criteria. The trigger thresholds are not provided in this question and cannot be calculated by the process simulator.
